scope: Read-only source triage; no edits, builds, lint reruns, device actions or acceptance claims. Reports are snapshots; parent is concurrently editing Orb/Home navigation/widget areas.

findings.message: Missing permissions required by CompanionDeviceManager.startObservingDevicePresence: android.permission.REQUEST_OBSERVE_COMPANION_DEVICE_PRESENCE
findings.evidence: The app manifest already declares REQUEST_OBSERVE_COMPANION_DEVICE_PRESENCE at app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:22; host-android library manifest declares only ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE. Both calls are SDK-gated and this is a library manifest contract mismatch, not a missing app permission.
findings.minimal_correct_fix: Declare the normal companion presence permission in the owning host-android manifest, or annotate observe with @RequiresPermission and keep the consuming app declaration. Prefer the manifest declaration because the host owns this capability. Preserve exact-association checks.
findings.verification: Lint host-android independently and inspect merged app permission; test permission-denied reporting without enabling observation.

findings.message: Call requires API level 30 (current min is 26): `android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService#getSystemActions`
findings.evidence: supported accepts an sdk argument defaulting to Build.VERSION.SDK_INT; all production callers use the default. Lint does not infer that parameter equals the real SDK. forDevice already provides a pure test seam.
findings.minimal_correct_fix: Guard the platform read directly with Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 30, and use sdk only for the pure filtering seam (or remove the sdk argument from supported and keep forDevice). This also prevents injected future SDKs touching unsupported APIs.
findings.verification: Host lint plus API26/29/30 supported-action tests; preserve advertised empty-set behavior.

findings.message: Call requires permission which may be rejected by user: code should explicitly check to see if permission is available (with `checkPermission`) or explicitly handle a potential `SecurityException`
findings.evidence: All six sites are guarded by hasConnectPermission() (including canInspectDevice alias and the early return at 332-335). That helper checks SDK<31 or checkSelfPermission(BLUETOOTH_CONNECT) at 495-496; lint cannot infer its result. No enclosing SecurityException handler protects the reads.
findings.minimal_correct_fix: Annotate the helper with @ChecksPermission(BLUETOOTH_CONNECT) so the contract is visible to lint, and wrap device name/bond snapshot reads in a narrow SecurityException fallback to preserve denied/revoked-permission state. Do not add blanket MissingPermission suppression.
findings.verification: Pairing permission-denied and permission-revoked snapshot tests; no property reads after failed permission gate; rerun app lint.

findings.message: Call requires API level 28 (current min is 26): `android.media.MediaPlayer#setPreferredDevice`
findings.evidence: Both Canvas media owners call setPreferredDevice (API28) with minSdk26 and no SDK guard; catch(Exception) does not catch NoSuchMethodError. The explicit built-in phone route is a safety requirement.
findings.minimal_correct_fix: Guard Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 28 before calling setPreferredDevice, failing closed with the existing unavailable UI on API26-27. Release resources on failure. Do not simply skip routing and let Android choose Bluetooth output/input.
findings.verification: API26/27 unavailable-result and resource-release tests; API28+ routing success/failure tests; app lint.

findings.message: Call requires API level 29 (current min is 26): `android.app.AutomaticZenRule#getConfigurationActivity`
findings.evidence: request checks Build.VERSION.SDK_INT>=29 at line24 before any of these calls. owns is called by request after that guard; its other current callers are SDK36 tests. Lint does not propagate Kotlin check() or caller guards through method references.
findings.minimal_correct_fix: Use an explicit SDK<29 return/throw before request API calls and a direct SDK>=29 short-circuit before owns reads configurationActivity; alternatively isolate API29 implementation in a @RequiresApi(29) helper called behind a direct guard. Preserve own-rule-only semantics.
findings.verification: App lint; API26/28 rejection with no rule writes; API29+ owned/unowned-rule regression tests.

findings.message: TileService#startActivityAndCollapse(Intent) is deprecated. Use TileService#startActivityAndCollapse(PendingIntent) instead.
findings.evidence: The deprecated Intent overload is confined to the SDK<34 branch; SDK34+ already uses immutable PendingIntent. Removing the older overload breaks supported older Android versions.
findings.minimal_correct_fix: Keep the compatibility branch and document a narrowly scoped @SuppressLint("StartActivityAndCollapseDeprecated") on an API<34 compatibility helper (not on the file or lint config). The modern branch remains unchanged.
findings.verification: Lint and SDK33/34 tile-launch tests; pending intent immutable; no direct microphone start.

findings.message: Suspicious indentation: This is conditionally executed; expected it to be indented
findings.evidence: The Kotlin syntax is unambiguous: Orb Button/TextButton are the immediate single-statement if bodies; HomeResponseCard Surface is unconditional. Indentation is misleading but there is no demonstrated changed runtime branch.
findings.minimal_correct_fix: Add braces to the two Orb conditionals and reindent the unconditional HomeResponseCard Surface. No behavioral rewrite and no suppression.
findings.verification: Kotlin compilation plus existing Orb visibility tests; parent owns Orb edits.

findings.message: Reading locale in a non-observable way in a composable function
findings.evidence: A composable directly reads Locale.getDefault for weekday names or capitalization. The global default is not an observable app-locale dependency and can differ from the configured app locale.
findings.minimal_correct_fix: Read the current configured locale from LocalConfiguration/LocalResources (or androidx.compose.ui.text.intl.Locale.current.platformLocale), then use it for display names/casing.
findings.verification: Switch app language without process restart; weekday labels and settings headers reflect current locale; lint.

findings.message: Reading locale in a non-observable way in a composable function
findings.evidence: Both composables already read LocalConfiguration.current.locales[0]; only the null fallback reads Locale.getDefault. Configuration changes already invalidate the primary locale.
findings.minimal_correct_fix: Use a stable explicit fallback such as Locale.ENGLISH for an empty configuration locale list, or a shared observable locale helper. Do not remove the LocalConfiguration read.
findings.verification: App locale switch tests including empty-locale fallback; lint.

findings.message: Reading Configuration using LocalContext.current.resources.configuration is not configuration-aware and may return stale values if the Configuration changes
findings.evidence: Test-only deterministic fixture clones the HostlessHaloTheme fontScale=2 configuration into a locale-specific resource context inside remember(original,tag). No production UI stale-read is established.
findings.minimal_correct_fix: Capture LocalConfiguration.current and key remember on it, then copy that observable configuration; alternatively build the controlled fixture outside composition with explicit locale/fontScale.
findings.verification: Rerun LocalizedMaterialBottomSheetTest to preserve inherited fontScale and localized Material strings; lint.

findings.message: Querying resource values using LocalContext.current is not configuration-aware and may return stale values if the Configuration changes
findings.evidence: The basic-device fallback label is rendered directly during composition using context.getString, unlike adjacent stringResource capability labels. It lacks a resource configuration observation.
findings.minimal_correct_fix: Resolve the fallback with stringResource(R.string.remote_ink_basic) in composition and use the resolved value in ifEmpty.
findings.verification: Language-switch test for a device with no optional capabilities; lint.

findings.message: Querying resource values using LocalContext.current is not configuration-aware and may return stale values if the Configuration changes
findings.evidence: The two getString calls execute only in the onRecovery event callback after startActivity throws, not while rendering composition. There is no unobserved rendered resource read at these sites.
findings.minimal_correct_fix: Resolve one failure string using stringResource in the surrounding composition and capture it in both callback catches. This makes locale ownership explicit without suppressing lint.
findings.verification: Recovery callback ActivityNotFoundException/SecurityException tests and current-language message test; lint.

findings.message: StateFlow.value should not be called within composition
findings.evidence: StateFlow.value reads occur while composing selected model Choice, Kids cloud notice or provider model display name; updates are not observed through these expressions. Onboarding already observes catalogue but not router selection.
findings.minimal_correct_fix: collectAsStateWithLifecycle the two router selection flows, Kids cloudAllowed flow and provider catalogue.state at the relevant composable scope; use those observed values in rendered text/selection.
findings.verification: Change each flow independently while screen remains composed and assert selection/text updates; lint.

findings.message: "app_name" is not translated in "ru" (Russian) or "lv" (Latvian)
findings.evidence: The brand/product name should remain the same across languages; supplying translated names is not the right acceptance requirement. Existing pl resource repeats Halo.
findings.minimal_correct_fix: Mark the canonical app_name resource translatable="false" (and align redundant locale overrides if appropriate). Preserve the approved halo spelling convention; do not mark consent copy nontranslatable.
findings.verification: App lint and launcher/app-label check in EN/LV/RU/PL.

findings.evidence: Six user-visible HaloModelLab consent strings are absent in values-ru and values-lv; values-pl contains translations. English fallback affects informed consent controls and explanation.
findings.minimal_correct_fix: Add accurate LV/RU translations for all six consent keys, preserving installed-model sharing, explicit local-test consent, provider/role immutability and no-cloud semantics. Respect the existing resource generation source if it owns these keys.
findings.verification: Localization consistency plus resource lint; render consent screen in LV/RU and verify full text/buttons.

findings.message: Permission exists without corresponding hardware `<uses-feature android:name="android.hardware.telephony" android:required="false" />` tag
findings.evidence: CALL_PHONE implies required telephony to Google Play unless the app declares telephony optional; current manifest declares camera and companion setup optional but no telephony declaration. Halo supports non-phone devices.
findings.minimal_correct_fix: Add <uses-feature android:name="android.hardware.telephony" android:required="false"/> to app manifest; retain capability/permission checks for call tools.
findings.verification: Merged manifest inspection and app lint; non-telephony install/feature availability checks when available.
